patches.change: Add trie_new_from_memory and bounded private readers for the unchanged big-endian alphabet/double-array/tail format. Validate ranges, count/byte-size bounds, signed suffix lengths, symbols, root/parent/free-list structure, cycles, tail references and exact input consumption; clean partial allocations on failure. The input is copied and may be released immediately. Keep upstream file APIs. Propagate allocation failures in alphabet file loading, symbol/relocation allocation, tail insertion/replacement and iterator construction.

Add th_brk_new_from_memory with existing trie ownership/destruction. Guard environment/root/clone allocation failures, release pooled nodes on best-break allocation failure and cloned state on position-buffer failure, and avoid zero-length copies from null root buffers. Matching and unknown-word recovery are unchanged.

integration: No new compilation unit. Existing forced-include NativeThaiAllocator.h routes allocations. LibThai's existing zero-boundary OOM return remains ABI-compatible: consumers must inspect the native allocator failure latch and discard partial boundaries.
memoryInputPolicy: One complete trie, without trailing bytes; ordered nonoverlapping positive alphabet ranges below INT32_MAX, at most 255 nonterminal symbols; suffix length at most INT16_MAX. Structural validation is linear in serialized cells/bytes, using one temporary byte per double-array cell.
